A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (23 December 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:SE-L-commanderwedgeantilles-PC-Errata-2022-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commander Wedge Antilles (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): The game text changes: “unable” becomes “not able”. This is a full card image again, drawn anew at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2022 D-E1 card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
